source_of_truth: Lovable Cloud backend and generated src/integrations/supabase/types.ts

environment.strategy: One managed backend currently serves preview and production; separate DEV/UAT/PROD environments are not evidenced in the repository.

auth.provider: Managed authentication; Android reuses the same account and session.
auth.authorization: RLS plus has_permission/has_role functions; never trust client-side roles.

storage.access: Permission-scoped private objects; signed URLs when download delivery requires it.
Server-issued signed upload token; quarantine/review workflow.
